content.name: Graham Fitzgerald
content.title: Enterprise Account Executive
content.summary: Enterprise account executive with 17 years in B2B technology sales across office systems, telecom and healthcare software. Sells multi-year analytics contracts to hospitals and provincial health agencies, carrying a $3.5M annual quota that I have exceeded in five of the last six years.

experience.title: Enterprise Account Executive
bullets: Carry a $3.5M annual quota selling population health analytics to hospitals and health agencies in Ontario and Atlantic Canada.
Closed a five-year, $7.2M agreement with a hospital network after leading a public RFP response with legal, privacy and clinical teams.
Navigated provincial procurement rules and broader public sector requirements on four competitive bids, winning three.
Built executive relationships with CIOs and chief nursing officers through quarterly business reviews, growing expansion revenue by 42%.
Coach three account executives on deal reviews, mutual action plans and public sector timelines.

experience.title: Senior Account Executive
bullets: Sold scheduling and workforce software to long-term care homes and community health centres, reaching 115% of quota on average.
Opened the Québec market with a francophone partner, signing 14 sites in 18 months.
Rewrote the proposal template around staffing cost savings, lifting win rates from 24% to 33%.

experience.title: Account Executive
bullets: Managed 140 mid-market accounts for business phone systems and network services in the Greater Toronto Area.
Converted 60 legacy phone customers to hosted VoIP in a year, raising recurring revenue on the book by $480,000.
Named top account executive for the region in 2014 and 2015.

experience.title: Inside Sales Representative
bullets: Sold copier and print management leases to small offices by phone, averaging 22 new contracts a quarter.
Renewed expiring leases ahead of term by offering upgrades, keeping renewal rates above 85%.
Kept CRM records clean so field reps could pick up accounts without re-qualifying them.
